label: Bees and bee health traceability
description: Honey bee and pollinator identification using hive registration, apiary records, beekeeper registration, and inspection records. Covers pest and disease control, import biosecurity, pollinator resilience, and ecosystem health including Varroa mites and exotic bee diseases.
